column1: # JX-3P PROVENANCE -- every file of the port (jx3p/src, jx3p/gen, jx3p/gui and the shared files the product builds),
# what it is, what made it, and the checks that prove it (JX-26e, docs/GATE_PARITY.tsv class provenance; the
# JUNO-60's PROVENANCE.tsv is per constant: here the JX's constants live in files made by generators from the booted
# plugin, each with a --check, or in code graded by the gates).
# jx3p/tools/jx_provenance.py reads it: every file has a row; a proof is a file jx3p/tools/jx_verify.sh runs; a
# RETIRED file is in no product build; every file the product builds has a row that is not RETIRED.
# role: PORTED (by hand from the plugin's code) | TRANSCRIBED (from the decompile, fixed by hand) | LIFTED (machine
#       code made C by the lifter) | GENERATED (from the booted plugin) | SHARED (the JUNO-60 port's file) |
#       RUNTIME (support code) | WEB (built for the page) | DATA (a generator's input or output) | RETIRED (not built)
